title: The Tu--Deng circular-addition inequality
summary: Bound the number of low-weight pairs representing a nonzero residue modulo 2^k - 1, and characterize when the half-cube bound is attained.

formal_statement.body: Let $M=2^k-1$ and $1\le t<M$. Define $S(t,k)=\{(a,b)\in\{0,\ldots,M-1\}^2:a+b\equiv t\pmod M,\operatorname{wt}_k(a)+\operatorname{wt}_k(b)<k\}$. Prove or refute $|S(t,k)|\le2^{k-1}$ for every $k\ge2$ and admissible $t$.

scope.domain: Circular addition, Boolean weights, and algebraic immunity
scope.unresolved_remainder: Priority and independence of competing complete-proof claims require an explicit literature audit.
